scripts.dev: VITE_ADMIN_PORT=9003 VITE_APP_PORT=9004 BOOTSTRAP_PORT=9006 UI_PORT=8888 npm run x
scripts.x: hc s clean && npm run build:happ && UI_PORT=8888 concurrently "npm start -w ui" "npm run start:happ" "npm run local-services"
scripts.tool-devy: concurrently "npm start -w ui" "sleep 1 && npm run weave -- --agent-idx 1 --dev-config weave/config.ts" "sleep 10 && npm run weave -- --agent-idx 2 --dev-config weave/config.ts --sync-time 20000"
scripts.network: hc s clean && npm run build:happ && concurrently "npm start -w ui" "hc-spin -n 2 --ui-port 8888 ./workdir/converge.webhapp"
scripts.test: npm run build:zomes && hc app pack workdir --recursive && npm test -w tests
scripts.package: rm -rf ui/dist ui/dist.zip && npm run build:happ && NODE_OPTIONS='--max-old-space-size=4096' npm run package -w ui && hc web-app pack workdir --recursive && npm run weave-hash
scripts.start:happ: echo "starting with admin $VITE_ADMIN_PORT" && RUST_LOG=warn echo "pass" | hc s -f=$VITE_ADMIN_PORT --piped generate workdir/converge.happ --run=$VITE_APP_PORT -a converge network -b "http://127.0.0.1:$BOOTSTRAP_PORT" quic "http://127.0.0.1:$BOOTSTRAP_PORT/relay"
scripts.build:happ: npm run build:zomes && hc app pack workdir --recursive
scripts.build:zomes: CARGO_TARGET_DIR=target RUSTFLAGS='--cfg getrandom_backend="custom"' cargo build --release --target wasm32-unknown-unknown
scripts.build:happ:release: npm run build:zomes && npm run optimize:zomes && hc app pack workdir --recursive
scripts.release:webhapp: APP_VER=$(node -p "require('./ui/package.json').version") && git tag v$APP_VER && git push origin v$APP_VER
